# `Q-12-8` — Listing Template File Missing

> The path given as `template:` does not exist or could not be
> read; the default built-in template is used instead.

## What this means

A listing with `type: custom` and `template: path/to/file`
expects to find that file on disk, relative to the document
that hosts the listing. This error fires when Quarto tries to
read the file and the read fails — usually because the path is
wrong, the file is missing, or the process does not have
permission to read it.

The listing falls back to the `default` built-in template so
the document still renders, but the layout will not match what
the custom template would have produced.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **A typo in the path** (`template: my-listng.template`).
- **The file moved or was renamed** but the `template:` value
  was not updated.
- **A path relative to the wrong base.** `template:` is
  resolved relative to the host document, not to the project
  root.

## How to fix

Confirm the file exists at the expected location. If you are
not sure where Quarto is looking, try an absolute path
temporarily — if that works, the original path was being
resolved against the wrong base directory.
